extraction.notes: Three-month (Q2 2023) column only. Starting line and all amounts taken from the dollar reconciliation on page 8 (seq 10); per-share table on page 9 (seq 11) confirms $0.28 FFO and $0.37 AFFO; 19,174,000 shares printed in full, converted to 19,174 thousand. Zero-value lines (gain on sale of real estate, loss on extinguishment of debt, insurance gains) shown as dashes in the printed table. Recurring capex is from the Capital Expenditures table (seq 28, page 10), which is printed in whole dollars ($1,470,000 BRT share), converted to thousands; that table is not a quarter-to-date AFFO deduction and the AFFO reconciliation does not subtract it. Company does not report a core FFO metric. Reconciliation starts from GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders as printed.
